title: Growth Strategy & Go-to-Market
description: Think like a growth marketer - acquisition, activation, retention. Tests AARRR funnels, referral design, and market expansion planning.

seo.overviewBody: Go-To-Market strategy guides how a product launches and captures market share. Growth leaders look for candidates who develop product positioning, select acquisition channels, model unit economics (LTV/CAC), and architect Product-Led Growth (PLG) viral acquisition loops.

deliverables.title: 1. Product Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy Deck
deliverables.desc: Comprehensive launch deck defining target market segments, competitive positioning, channel strategies, and pricing tiers.

deliverables.title: 2. Growth Loop & Customer Acquisition Spec
deliverables.desc: Specification detailing viral referral loops, content acquisition loops, or paid acquisition flywheels.

deliverables.title: 3. GTM Launch Execution & Milestone Timeline
deliverables.desc: Phase-by-phase launch roadmap mapping pre-launch teaser, launch day push, and post-launch retention activities.

faqs.question: What is Product-Led Growth (PLG)?
faqs.answer: PLG is a business methodology where the product itself (via free trials or freemium tiers) drives customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.

faqs.question: What is a compounding growth loop?
faqs.answer: A growth loop is a closed system where the output of one user action feeds back into input for acquiring new users (e.g. viral referral invites).

faqs.question: How do you validate product-market fit (PMF)?
faqs.answer: PMF is validated when organic user retention flattens into a stable horizontal baseline, or when >40% of surveyed users report being 'very disappointed' if the product disappeared.
